title: Asymptotically Good Quantum Locally Testable Codes
abstract: We construct explicit families of asymptotically good quantum locally testable codes over qubits. More precseily, we construct explicit quantum LDPC CSS codes over qubits having constant rate, constant relative distance and constant weight local testers with constant soundness.

bite.hook: We construct explicit families of asymptotically good quantum locally testable codes over qubits.
tldr: Constructed explicit families of asymptotically good quantum locally testable codes over qubits.
Built explicit quantum LDPC CSS codes over qubits featuring constant rate and distance.
Proved the existence of constant weight local testers with constant soundness.
bite.whyItMatters: Quantum error correction is vital for building fault-tolerant quantum computers, and locally testable codes allow checking for errors efficiently without reading out the entire fragile quantum state.
bite.eli5: Imagine trying to find a single typo in a massive library book without reading every page. These new codes are like special error-checking patterns that let you instantly spot where the mistakes are hidden using only a tiny glance.
